START HERE

Your first run

Azeroth Survivors is a free browser survival roguelike by Aethus. Choose a race, class, and zone; move through enemy waves while your abilities cast automatically.

  1. Choose a race and class. Paladin or Warrior is a forgiving way to learn; Hunter suits ranged play.
  2. Select Elwynn Forest. It is the first open zone on a fresh save.
  3. Start and keep moving. Enemies spawn around you; your attacks fire on their own.
  4. Collect experience and choose a card. Prepare for timed bosses and the 16-minute finale.

Want to play now? The game is hosted by its creator. Open it from the button below; the first load may take a while.

QUICK CONTROL GUIDE

How to control your hero

Abilities cast automatically, so movement and upgrade choices do most of the work. Controls can change between builds; check the current Options screen if an input differs.

InputActionWhen to use it
W A S D / arrowsMoveKeep distance and guide the horde behind you.
NoneAutomatic spellsAttacks target nearby enemies without manual aiming.
1 2 3 / clickChoose upgradePick one of three cards at level-up.
Mouse wheelZoomAdjust your camera view.
CCharacter panelReview character stats when available in your build.
EscPause / optionsPause and adjust game settings.
Gamepad / touchAlternate controlsSupported on some devices; desktop is easiest to learn on.

See the full first-run guide for positioning and upgrade tips.

ROSTER

Which class should you pick?

Start with the kind of run you enjoy. Paladin and Warrior are commonly recommended for forgiving starts; Hunter lets you fight from range. Mage and Warlock can scale into heavy damage but ask you to protect a fragile hero. These are play-style suggestions, not a permanent ranking: talents and balance change between builds.

ClassPlay styleTry this approach
PaladinDurable meleeBuild around shields, healing, or one holy damage spell.
HunterRangedKeep moving; choose one focus such as pets, traps, or a signature shot.
WarriorClose-range bruiserUse toughness to learn routes, then stack a focused damage plan.
MageArea damagePair crowd clear with health, slows, or a defensive companion.
DruidFlexible hybridCombine sustain with an area spell or control effect.
ShamanChain damage and supportPrioritize effects that jump between enemies and helpful totems.
RogueFast meleeUse mobility to avoid being surrounded; focus on crit or elite damage.
PriestDefense and damage over timeUse shields to buy time while a damage effect spreads.
WarlockDamage over time and petsPick a curse or demon synergy and strengthen it instead of taking every spell.

For more detail, see the build and progression guide. Confirm current talent names and effects in the game's picker.

BUILD YOUR RUN

Choose your upgrade cards

Each level offers three cards. A card shows the change it makes, such as more damage or an extra target. Early on, damage and target count help you keep up with growing waves. Before a boss, consider health, healing, and movement. If none of the offers fit your plan, use a reroll when your current build provides one; check the in-game controls because key bindings and reroll costs can change.

Abilities unlock as you level, so your build changes through both the cards you choose and the spells your class gains.

PROGRESSION

Twelve zones to explore

Available guide sources describe a 12-zone chain, with progress unlocked separately for each class. Use the in-game zone panel as the final authority if an update changes the order.

11Gates of Ahn'QirajC'Thun
12NaxxramasKel'Thuzad

Elwynn Forest boss clock

Hogger arrives at 3:00, Mother Fang at 6:00, Rhahk'Zor at 9:00, Mr. Smite at 12:00, and Edwin VanCleef closes the first zone at 16:00. The detailed zone guide reports longer runs later in the chain: 18 minutes in zones 5–8 and 20 minutes in zones 9–12. Check the current zone panel for updated timing.

See the complete zone progression and run-planning guide.

BEFORE LAUNCH

Browser requirements & fixes

The browser game requires WebGPU and a compatible graphics adapter. A current Chrome or Edge is a practical starting point; support in Safari and Firefox depends on the device and version. A desktop keyboard is recommended.

Black screen or no WebGPU?

  • Update your browser, then reload the creator's game page.
  • Allow extra time on the first visit while the world data loads.
  • On a laptop with two GPUs, try assigning the browser to the high-performance GPU.
  • If browser play is unavailable, check the Windows download on the creator's website.

Some phones can run the game with touch controls, but performance and WebGPU support vary.

QUICK ANSWERS

FAQ

Is Azeroth Survivors an official Blizzard game?

No. It is a fan project made by Aethus. This guide is also independent and has no affiliation with Blizzard Entertainment.

Do I press a key to attack?

No. Abilities cast themselves at nearby enemies. Your job is movement, dodging, kiting, and collecting experience.

How long is a zone?

Elwynn Forest's final boss arrives at 16:00. Later zones may have different timers; check the zone panel before starting.

Why did my save disappear?

The game's save belongs to the browser and game website where you played. Private windows, clearing site data, changing browsers, or playing from a different site can make another save appear empty. Export from the original game page before moving it. See our save recovery steps.

Can I play offline?

The creator's page may offer a Windows build. Follow the download link from the creator's official site.

Ready to try it? Open the creator's game page and start in Elwynn Forest.
